[root.GetName]，

我们目前正遭受攻击，必须立刻召回己方武装。根据合约相关条款，[mercenary_fleet.GetName]将即刻停止为您服务。

texts.en:
We have received communication from the [mercenary_enclave_country.GetName]:

[root.GetName],

We are under attack, and must therefore recall our own forces immediately. In accordance with our contract, the [mercenary_fleet.GetName] will leave your service forthwith.

We trust that you will understand the urgency of this situation and the necessity of our actions.

texts.zh:
尊敬的客户：

由于目前遭受攻击，我们迫切需要召回自己的舰队。根据合同第285b条，我们的舰队将在收到通知后立即停止为您服务。不过一旦我们将这一不幸的局势处理完毕，我们就将恢复我们的合作关系，并对由此带来的不便表示歉意。
texts.en:
Dear valued client,

As we currently find ourselves under attack, we have urgent need to recall our own forces. As per our contract, we will immediately enact clause 285b.15, and our fleet will leave your service as soon as this notice reaches you. We look forward to renewing our partnership once this unfortunate situation is resolved, and apologize for any inconvenience.

label.zh: 我们下次应该好好读读合同条款各项细则。
label.en: We should have read the small print.
